§6ZIRNOX Nuclear Reactor§f

§aYour first reactor. It's cheap, it's simple, and it won't kill you if you read the manual.§f

The §bZIRNOX GCR§f is a single-block gas-cooled reactor, not a modular multiblock. You build it, fuel it, and it produces §esuper dense steam§f. That's the good news.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Machine, 30s, 100 HE/t):
§b•§f 4× Steel Shell, 8× Steel Pipe, 8× Boron Ingot, 16× Graphite Ingot
§b•§f 16× Rubber Bar, 16× Concrete, 4× Integrated Circuit Board

§6The GUI§f:
§b•§f §bFuel Rod Assembly§f, center rods deplete faster than edge rods
§b•§f §bControl Rod§f, on/off switch for the reaction
§b•§f §bTemperature§f, hard cap at §e800°C§f; meltdown above that
§b•§f §bPressure§f, hard cap at §e30 BAR§f; also causes meltdown
§b•§f §bCO2§f (§e16,000 mB§f), §bWater§f (§e32,000 mB§f), §bSteam§f (§e8,000 mB§f)

§cWARNING:§f Super dense steam stuck in the reactor turns it into a radiation bomb. Get your pipe setup right before you turn it on.

The ZIRNOX is a stepping stone, not an endgame reactor. It burns fuel fast and produces modest power. Use it to get your first fission products, then move on to a PWR or RBMK.
